description: Source code for the PlayerInfo plugin implementation in the WPEFramework, handling initialization, deinitialization, request processing, and codec information retrieval.

classes.name: PlayerInfo
classes.description: Implementation of the PlayerInfo plugin, managing player properties, codecs, and responses.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PlayerInfo plugin, setting up codecs, notifications, and Dolby output.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications, releases codecs, and terminates connections.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests; currently no implementation.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests, primarily GET requests to return player codec info in JSON format.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Info
methods.description: Populates the JSON response with current audio and video codecs.

methods.name: PlayerInfo::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation, scheduling cleanup.
